# Obed Abernethy

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixty  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v1 c37 P8](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0008), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley, St. Brendan's Island  <sub>[v1 c1 P0](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0000), [v1 c1 P5](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0005), [v1 c2 P2](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0002)</sub>
- **Role:** Farmer  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P19](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0019)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Agatha Sowerby's husband  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002)</sub>

## Appearance

He is an unusual-appearing man with an awkward frame, lengthy iron-gray hair reaching his hunching shoulders, and a thick, gentle brown beard.

_Sources: [v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)_

## Personality

He is extremely timid, bashful, and quiet, preferring to avoid unfamiliar people and places where he might need to converse. Despite his taciturn nature, he possesses a deep, gentle empathy and kindness toward children, quietly showing a stubborn determination when his heart is set on something.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P4](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0004), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P27](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0027), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c2 P74](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0074), [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021)_

- Quiet and bashful  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027)</sub>

## Abilities

- Farming and manual labor  <sub>[v1 c1 P2](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0002), [v1 c6 P29](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0029)</sub>

## Goals

- To adopt an orphan boy to help him with farm work in his advancing age  <sub>[v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023)</sub>
- To keep Nell Harcourt at Grey Shutters and provide her with a good home  <sub>[v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c6 P30](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0030), [v1 c25 P60](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0060)</sub>

## History

Obed Abernethy resided at Grey Shutters in Brierley with his sister, Thirza. Advancing in age and suffering from heart trouble, he decided with his sister to adopt a ten- or eleven-year-old orphan boy from Nova Scotia to assist with farm labor. When Obed drove to the Alder River station to collect the child, he discovered an eleven-year-old red-haired girl named Nell Harcourt instead of the expected boy due to a mix-up in messages. Unwilling to leave her stranded, he brought her back to Grey Shutters and quickly grew fond of her chattering company during the ride. Although Thirza originally intended to send the girl back or pass her on to a neighbor, Obed's quiet determination and sympathy persuaded Thirza to let Nell remain permanently. Over the next four years, Obed doted on Nell, regularly buying her small treats and even secretly arranging for a new dress with puffed sleeves for her. Shortly before Nell completed her entrance examinations for college, the Abbey Bank unexpectedly failed, wiping out all of the family's savings. The sudden shock of receiving the news caused Obed to suffer a fatal heart attack on his doorstep.

_Sources: [v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006), [v1 c1 P23](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0023), [v1 c2 P4](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0004), [v1 c2 P6](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0006), [v1 c2 P17](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0017), [v1 c2 P27](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0027), [v1 c3 P55](../source/v01-c03.md#nw-v01-c03-p0055), [v1 c6 P30](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0030), [v1 c6 P31](../source/v01-c06.md#nw-v01-c06-p0031), [v1 c12 P43](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0043), [v1 c25 P25](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0025), [v1 c25 P32](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0032), [v1 c36 P33](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0033), [v1 c37 P0](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0000), [v1 c37 P8](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0008), [v1 c37 P9](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0009)_

## Background by volume

- Raised in Grey Shutters by a father who was as bashful and quiet as himself  <sub>[v1 c1 P6](../source/v01-c01.md#nw-v01-c01-p0006)</sub>
- Has worn a thick brown beard since the age of twenty  <sub>[v1 c2 P3](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0003)</sub>
